verdict.rationale: Working Copy's docs describe a 'Repository Agent' AI assistant you converse with to browse files, search content, read/modify files, commit, pull and push — directly matching the ai-native conversational insight story for repositories. However, there is no explicit mention of pull-request insights/management via this agent, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the feature's real-world behavior. missing for 10: explicit pull-request conversational insight capability, independent/hands-on verification of the Repository Agent's conversational quality.
